newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel shuns talks with PLO over settlement 'pause'.
newsitem.headline: Israel shuns talks with PLO over settlement 'pause'.

text.p: Israel said it would refuse to take part in revived peace talks with the Palestinians on Sunday until the PLO retracted statements that Israel had agreed to a pause in Jewish settlement construction.

"We told Egypt the Israeli delegation will not be able to go to Cairo until there is an unequivocal denial from the Palestinian Authority that will make clear that Israel did not give any commitment to the Palestinians in order to conduct the meeting in Cario. The delegation is waiting at this time in Jerusalem until there is a denial. I make clear again that no commitment was given to stop the settlements," Israeli spokesman Shai Bazak said.
